title: 副词角色卡接力｜一词一人物、一动作一图形世界
source_title: 五种语气海报片｜动漫成年角色演出副词含义
summary: 五个准确短词各绑定一个不同成年动漫角色、主色和动作语气；字形既是标题也是构图结构，章节间用字母形状或光带擦屏，最终五名角色与五个词在同一版式汇合。
input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, three identity anchors and one continuous world axis. + Bind each decisive action to exactly one short original semantic word that appears only after the action begins. + Make each word occupy, divide, reflect or redirect the physical environment rather than float as a subtitle. + Escalate typography scale and spatial depth while preserving identity, travel direction and readable action. + Return to the same adult face or full-body anchor and resolve the word sequence into one terminal identity proof.
recommended_input: 把准确单词【PRECISELY】与一名原创成年制图师绑定在黑白线框网格中。；把【WILDLY】与一名成年鼓手绑定在青洋红撕纸爆发中，并安排一次有力转头。；让五名成年人在准确标题【FIVE MODES】下汇合，每个单词仍与对应人物和颜色相邻。
required_anchors: Exactly five short words map one-to-one to five clearly adult characters.
Each chapter uses a distinct palette, pose and graphic grammar.
Transitions reuse letter shapes or graphic motifs rather than random cuts.
The final board preserves all five mappings simultaneously.
